types.name: Runtime
types.doc: Child runtime identity, carried inside the hello frame.

types.name: EventPayload
types.doc: Typed event payload. Exactly one field is set per event name (see widgets.json events[].payload): changed/activate/navigate/titleChanged -> text, toggled/loadingChanged/backAvailable/forwardAvailable -> checked, valueChanged -> value, selectionChanged -> index, clicked -> none, styleError -> key (the offending style key, M5c-D7). Serialized with emit_null_optional_fields=false, so clicked still wires as "payload":{} — byte-compatible with M4.

frames.name: helloAck
frames.doc: Handshake reply. `encodings` lists CommitBatch encodings the host accepts, host-preference order (ndp-binary spec §2); the runtime picks the first one it supports. `backend` names the host's active widget backend ("gtk" | "appkit") — the authoritative source for `Platform.backend`, since the OS alone can't distinguish it (GTK runs on macOS too).

frames.name: event
frames.doc: `name` is one of widgets.json's event ndpNames (clicked | changed | activate | toggled | valueChanged | selectionChanged | ...) or styleError.

frames.name: runtimeError
frames.doc: Best-effort report of an uncaught exception / unhandled rejection, sent before the child exits so the host's crash overlay (M8) shows the real error instead of a bare disconnect.

frames.name: pluginCommand
frames.doc: Dispatches a loaded native plugin's command (M10); gated on the plugin:<plugin>.<command> capability host-side.

frames.name: pluginResult
frames.doc: Reply to pluginCommand, carrying the plugin's JSON result verbatim (host-validated to be well-formed JSON before splicing).

frames.name: widgetCommand
frames.doc: Imperative command on a live widget node (M14 WebView: goBack/goForward/reload/stop). `command` must be one of the node's widget's schema-declared commands (widgets.json commands[]); unknown commands are dropped host-side with ND_WARN. Ordered on the same socket as commitBatch, so a command sent after a commit always sees that commit applied.
